note: Written blind by a Claude subagent on 2026-09-29: no router code, prompts, search_tuning.json or other eval sets were read; browser_holdout2.json was opened only to copy the JSON shape. Labelling policy: label each request by the provider that would genuinely give the best answer. tinyfish = one fact, a definition, hours, a price or policy stated on a public page, what one specific doc says, or a simple comparison from a few pages. perplexity = breaking news or current events, anything whose answer may have changed recently, multi-hop, open-ended or ambiguous questions, and comparisons that need many sources; when torn between tinyfish and perplexity the label is perplexity (quality first). firecrawl = only when a live structured data tool answers directly: flight fares from a fare service, and government or official records. 'tricky' marks deliberately borderline cases.
